name: toolkit-core
description: phData Toolkit CLI foundation: verify/install the toolkit binary, configure shell PATH, initialize a toolkit project, configure JDBC connections and datasources (Snowflake, SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, Hive, Databricks, Athena), and optionally configure the LLM client for toolkit agent commands. Bundles the shared preflight check every phData plugin runs, including whether Python 3 — which all of their scripts need — is installed. Required by all phData workflow plugins.
